propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui per immaculatam Virginis Conceptionem dignum Filio tuo habitaculum
praeparasti: supplices a te quaesumus; ut, ejusdem Virginis Apparitionem
celebrantes, salutem mentis et corporis consequamur. Per eundem Dominum.

Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

propers.text: Tu gloria Jerusalem, tu laetitia Israel, tu honorificentia populi nostri. V. Tota pulchra es, Maria: et macula originalis non est in te. V. Felix es, sacra Virgo Maria, et omni laude dignissima, quae serpentis caput virgineo pede contrivisti.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: You are the glory of Jerusalem, you are the joy of Israel, you are the honor of our people. V. You are wholly beautiful, Mary, and the stain of original sin is not in you. V. Blessed are you, holy Virgin Mary, most worthy of every praise, who crushed the serpent's head with your virgin foot.
